assets.theme: Raised Dot and Ridge Paving Samples with Open Callout Space
assets.palette: warm stone, muted ochre, pale clay, charcoal
assets.prompt: Create a 4K 16:9 architectural materials illustration for a public space training slide or a landscape specification board. Arrange two separate square paving samples on a neutral light field, both seen from the same shallow three quarter direction. The left sample has short raised round studs in a regular grid, and the right sample has parallel rounded ribs along one axis. Use restrained mineral colors and fine nonuniform aggregate so the broad form remains readable when reduced. Rake a broad soft light across the relief from the upper left and keep the thin exposed edges visible. Set the samples in the middle height of the frame with an open gutter and quiet margins above for editor supplied captions. Maintain complete perimeter clearance so each sample can be cropped as an inset. Show physical surface differences without suggesting a layout specification. Omit letters, dimensions, compliance marks, streets, arrows, and branding.
assets.negative_prompt: street scene, warning signs, arrows, compliance symbols, road crossing layout, measurements, text, logos

assets.theme: Oil Droplet Dispersion beside Settled Oil and Water
assets.palette: warm yellow, pale blue, porcelain white, slate
assets.prompt: Make a 4K horizontal 16:9 food science plate for a classroom worksheet or a culinary training article. Place two low rectangular vessel cross sections at the same height and scale on an unbroken ivory field. In the first show a pale liquid below a cohesive golden oil layer with one clear boundary. In the second show small rounded golden droplets dispersed throughout a continuous very pale blue liquid, with no intact surface oil band. Draw both views frontally using soft colored pigment, fine contour lines and restrained diffuse illumination. The simplified vessel rims should read clearly without decorative caustics. Keep the empty central gutter wide and both sample silhouettes complete for cropping. Reserve a clean strip above the vessels for labels added by the designer, and preserve the quiet area below for a short caption. Present a qualitative teaching schematic with no numerical scales, type, emulsifier claims, logos, or utensils.
assets.negative_prompt: foam bubbles, salad, pouring stream, kitchen scene, fake instrument scales, labels, logo

assets.theme: Matched Object and Pixel Mask for Image Segmentation
assets.palette: stone, terracotta, muted teal, white, charcoal
assets.prompt: Create a clean 4K horizontal 16:9 reference plate for image segmentation documentation or a computer vision workbook. On the left show one generic terracotta ring shaped object with an irregular but simple outline and a clearly visible central opening. View the piece from directly above, with diffuse light shading the material subtly and only a thin contact shadow. On the right show the corresponding binary mask at exactly the same scale and orientation. The mask should fill the identical outer form in rich muted teal and leave the same central opening in a uniform off white field. Use crisp technical illustration, restrained grain on the object and completely flat values on the mask. Keep a wide central gutter, safe perimeter margins and generous quiet space above both views for separate educator captions. Let designers crop each view independently. Exclude interface mockups, data labels, boundary boxes, letters, brand shapes and transparency grids.
assets.negative_prompt: bounding boxes, code, charts, dashboard, checkerboard, extra holes, contour mismatch, logo

assets.theme: Two Layer Rubber Tile with Exposed Recycled Granule Base
assets.palette: coal, charcoal, low saturation olive, warm gray
assets.prompt: Render a horizontal 16:9 4K industrial material study for a surface supplier specification sheet or a circular materials report. Show the cropped corner of a generic bonded rubber tile resting on a warm gray matte field. Let one near edge reveal a thick charcoal base of recycled rubber granules bonded below a thinner muted olive wear layer. Use a credible continuous interface with no black gap between layers. Show finer colored granules at the top and slightly larger irregular dark granules below. Use one broad raking source from the upper left so shallow pores and the matte grain separate without crushed shadows. Set the material within the left half and leave the right half quiet for layout and annotation. Give the near corner enough clearance to crop as a standalone detail. Keep color and scale restrained and omit products, logos, watermarks, numbers, performance grades, sport markings and room context.
assets.negative_prompt: tread patterns, sponge holes, asphalt road, playground scene, safety rating, text, logos

assets.theme: Spouted Pouch Closure with Visible Tamper Band Gap
assets.palette: warm gray, pale teal, ivory, charcoal
assets.prompt: Create a 4K horizontal 16:9 packaging engineering illustration for a flexible pouch specification page or a customer opening guide. Show only the upper corner of a generic refill pouch, its short molded spout, and a plain threaded cap hovering just above the neck on the same axis. Keep a narrow separated tamper band seated below the external threads so the gap reads directly at thumbnail size. At the base show a believable transition where flexible matte laminate meets the thicker molded fitment, with a quiet weld line and a few broad folds. Place the assembly on the left side of a uniform warm gray field. Reserve the right side for callouts and keep the cap and full neck inside generous crop margins. Use clean three quarter product illustration and broad diffuse studio light. Omit contents, retail labeling, certification icons, text, marks and recognizable commercial closure designs.
assets.negative_prompt: trademarked fitment, exact patent geometry, recycling badge, liquid pour, checkerboard, label, logo

assets.theme: Polarization Glare Comparison over the Same Slate Surface
assets.palette: dark slate, pale cream, silver gray
assets.prompt: Create a 4K horizontal 16:9 teaching illustration for an optics lesson or a material photography guide. Show two matched shallow angle views of one dark honed slate tile, each with identical dimensions, orientation and fine mineral marks. On the left depict a broad pale reflected band from an off frame source passing across the tile at an oblique angle. On the right keep that band in the same position but render it much weaker, allowing the original slate detail to remain visible at the same overall exposure. Treat the panels as two separate editorial crops on a single warm cream field. Preserve a broad central gutter and blank caption space above each tile. Use refined optical illustration with subdued gray mids, soft highlights and clean polygonal edges. Make a qualitative depiction of reducing polarized reflection. Leave out cameras, lenses, beam arrows, numeric claims, logos and text.
assets.negative_prompt: camera body, lenses, eyewear, infographic arrows, fake measurement, text, logo
